★★★★ Pretty good for $39, with a few quirks

Ok so I bought this because my toaster oven died and I didn't want to spend a ton. Been using it about three weeks now. Fries come out great, like actually crispy, which surprised me. Chicken thighs were good too, took maybe 22 min at 400 and the skin was nice.

Things that annoy me: the basket is kind of a pain to clean. The nonstick stuff is already getting a little scratched near the edge and I've only washed it by hand. Also it's LOUD. Not jet engine loud but my husband yelled from the other room asking what was that noise the first time.

The dial is also kind of vague?? Like the temp markings don't match up exactly so I just kinda guess and check. Burned a batch of frozen tots because of that, oops.

Smells like hot plastic the first two uses, then goes away. Don't panic if that happens.

It's small too, maybe 2 people max unless you cook in batches. I do wish I had gotten the bigger one but whatever. For the price I'm not mad. Would buy again probably.
